summary: GKE alpha clusters now enable all alpha and default beta feature gates, and you can modify those gates from their default values.
extended_definition: GKE alpha clusters now enable all alpha and default beta feature gates, and you can modify those gates from their default values.

supporting_pages.title: Alpha clusters \_|\_ Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: With alpha clusters, GKE enables the following: Alpha feature gates : all feature gates at the alpha stages that are available with the Kubernetes version of your cluster Beta feature gates : the feature gates at the beta stages that are available with the Kubernetes version of your cluster, and which are enabled by default by open source Kubernetes For more information about which feature gates are available for a specific Kubernetes version, and which beta features are enabled by default ( true ), see Feature gates for Alpha or Beta features in the Kubernetes documentation.

Limitations for enabling feature gates with alpha clusters When you enable feature gates with alpha clusters, understand the following additional limitations: You can only create alpha clusters with specific feature gates by using the gcloud CLI.
By default, alpha clusters have all alpha feature gates enabled that are available with the Kubernetes version.
